SOUL YARD

Charting the island…

PIMENTO ISLE · 17° 58′ N, 76° 47′ W
FIELD MANUAL

How to survive the yard

01

Shoot to expose

Fire aether bolts to weaken a spirit. Below 35% health its soul becomes exposed — it can no longer die, only be bonded.

LMB fire SHIFT dash
02

Throw the orb

Throw a soul orb at an exposed spirit to capture it. Guardians must be defeated first. Orbs slowly recharge; wild spirits sometimes drop them.

RMB or E throw
03

Bond & battle

Your active bond follows you into combat and lends its element to your shots. Fire beats air, air beats earth, earth beats water, water beats fire. Spirit and shadow prey on each other.

1–4 switch bond
04

Read the island

Purify the three Wardens at their shrines, then face Anansi Unbound at the Great Silk Cotton. Elder Nya can heal you and refill your orbs.

TAB bonds M mute
